svg.title: To prove this passage, pull every slot back by U−1 k,di. Regular slots become constant labels; stress slots converge to T 0,tr aibi by the physical stress comparison and its Ward normalization. Expand the resulting finite-dimensional labels in a fixed basis. The common compact jet comparison handles the finitely many basis moments, while coordinate convergence and compact boundedness of the free derivatives handle the varying coefficients. This proves the mixed statement with any number of stress slots. The construction of the sequence supplies the mean hierarchy, derivatives, rotations and physical stress on the same table as the selected and reconstructed theory; no change of continuum witness is made here.
